headline: VR RESOURCES HITS 317m AT 0.77% CuEq FROM SURFACE AT NEW BOSTON — NEVADA PORPHYRY STOCK SURGES 148%
snippet: VR Resources (TSXV: VRR) drilled 317 metres at 0.77% CuEq starting at surface in hole NB26-003 at the New Boston moly-copper-tungsten-silver-zinc porphyry-skarn system in west-central Nevada, including 84 metres at 1.78% CuEq and a 2-metre garnet marble skarn intercept at 33.43% CuEq — with near-continuous sulphide veining across all 881 metres of the hole. Shares surged 148% to top the TSXV gainers list on over 8 million shares, confirming that the team behind $1.3 billion in prior mining exits may have found a district-scale polymetallic system.

headline: KORYX COPPER DRILLS 969m AT 0.27% CuEq FROM SURFACE AT HAIB — 30m AT 1.10% CuEq FROM 8m IN NAMIBIA
snippet: Koryx Copper (TSXV: KRY) released assay results from 19 holes (8,586 metres) at the Haib Copper Project in southern Namibia: standout hole HM167 returned 969 metres at 0.27% CuEq from surface, while HM177 hit 30 metres at 1.10% CuEq starting from just 8 metres depth. Haib is one of Africa's largest undeveloped copper porphyries, and today's results confirm both bulk-tonnage scale at depth and near-surface high-grade zones that could underpin open-pit economics.

headline: WARSH'S JACKSON HOLE DEBUT FRIDAY: GOLD EYES $4,700 BREAKOUT OR $4,400 RETEST — MINERS ON EDGE
snippet: Gold holds near $4,620 as investors brace for Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's inaugural Jackson Hole keynote on Friday August 28 — his first major public remarks since taking the chairmanship in May 2026. Under Warsh's deliberate policy of opacity, the speech carries genuine information value: a dovish lean could push gold through $4,700 resistance, while a hawkish surprise risks a retest of $4,400 support, with junior miners leveraged 2-to-1 on gold price moves in either direction.

headline: K2 GOLD CONFIRMS Ag-Au-Cu CORRIDORS AT MORNINGSTAR — 613 ROCK SAMPLES SET UP DRILL CAMPAIGN IN CALIFORNIA
snippet: K2 Gold Corporation (TSXV: KTO) published assay results from 613 rock chip and grab samples at the Morningstar Target in Inyo County, California, identifying discrete high-grade silver, gold, and copper trends across multiple surface corridors. The program has defined priority drill targets in a historically prolific polymetallic district, with a drill campaign expected to follow.

headline: GREENLAND MINES PRICES $20M OFFERING TO ACQUIRE SARFARTOQ Nd-Pr RARE EARTH PROJECT IN GREENLAND
snippet: Greenland Mines Ltd. (Nasdaq: GRML) priced a $20 million institutional offering at $5.00 per share to fund the acquisition of the Sarfartoq Neodymium-Praseodymium Rare Earth Element Project in Greenland plus working capital. The deal adds a Greenlandic Nd-Pr magnet metal asset to the public markets as Western governments and manufacturers push to build non-Chinese supply chains for EV motor and wind turbine rare earth magnets.

headline: GOLD HITS 3-MONTH HIGH ABOVE $4,680 ON WEAK DOLLAR AND CENTRAL BANK DEMAND — JACKSON HOLE WEEK OPENS WITH MINERS OVERBOUGHT
snippet: Gold rallied to a three-month high above $4,680 on August 24 as a weakening US dollar, persistent central bank accumulation, and surging retail ETF inflows converged ahead of the Jackson Hole symposium and July PCE inflation data. The GDX gold miners ETF climbed to RSI 73.49 — technically overbought territory — while analysts argue that peak real yields appear to be behind us, a macro condition that has historically sustained precious metals rallies for multiple quarters.

headline: ANALYSTS FLAG PAN AMERICAN SILVER, ALAMOS, IAMGOLD AND ENDEAVOUR AS CANADA'S BEST MARGIN-EXPANSION PLAYS INTO Q3
snippet: Kalkine's August 2026 Canadian mining watchlist highlights Pan American Silver, Alamos Gold, IAMGOLD, and Endeavour Mining as mid-tier producers with the strongest case for margin expansion heading into Q3 earnings season, with AISC improvements of roughly 5% year-over-year against gold prices up 24%. The analysis argues these names trade at multi-year P/NAV discounts despite delivering record quarterly cash flows — historically a setup that precedes sector re-rating events.
